newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Capital Intelligence upgrades TAIB bank rating.
newsitem.headline: Capital Intelligence upgrades TAIB bank rating.

text.p: Capital Intelligence has upgraded the long and short-term ratings of Bahrain-based TAIB Bank EC to BBB-/A-2 from BB+/A-3, the Cyprus-based specialist bank rating agency announced.
A stable outlook has been assigned, Capital Intelligence said in a press release.

Established in 1979, TAIB Bank operates under an investment bank licence issued by the Bahrain Monetary Agency. It is a niche player specialising in the provision of trade finance, treasury and investment services in markets where it has a deep and intimate local knowledge, particularly the Middle East, Turkey and Central Asia, and the Indian sub-continent.
In 1996, TAIB Bank strengthened its financial position on a number of fronts, including its funding profile, underlying profitabilty and asset quality.
Although the bank remains small by international standards, with total assets of $307 million at end 1995, it is very strongly capitalised for the risks it undertakes, the agency said.

TAIB Bank expects to launch its new majority-owned bank TAIB Kazak Bank, in Almaty, Kazakhstan in the near future, which will add substance to its focus on Central Asia. The Bank is very well positioned to take advantage of growing interest in the region, Capital Intelligence said.
